## Release — backlog-campaign v0.26.0

### ✨ New in v0.26.0

#### A status page for your campaign

- `bun run status --json` prints the campaign state as structured data, and `bun run status --html` writes a self-contained page (default `.blackhole/.tmp/status.html`, or the path given with `--out`). The numbers match the text dashboard ([#1107](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1107)).
- The page opens with a **Ready to merge** panel: each pull request that has passed review, has no conflict and has green CI gets direct links to the PR and its changed files. Below it come what is waiting on you, what is in motion, what is blocked and why, recent events and open findings.
- In Claude Code the page is published as one artifact that is refreshed at the same link. In Cursor it refreshes a canvas named `Blackhole status`. Elsewhere the local path is printed.
- Turn it off with `status_page.enabled: false` in the campaign config.

### 🐛 Fixed in v0.26.0

#### Installed plugin no longer crashes without a package.json

- Scripts that run from an installed plugin used to fail at start-up because the plugin ships no `package.json`. They now fall back to the plugin manifest for the project name and version ([#1106](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1106)).
